analysis.action: Adopt mandatory inclusionary zoning that requires at least 20 % of new units to be affordable for low‑ and moderate‑income households, combined with a city‑wide housing trust to acquire and preserve existing affordable stock

raw_items.title: Biking in US cities is getting better, 2026 report says
